_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Muthu wa Muthu vs Muthu wa Kasa

📖 NZINGA YA MUTHU:
• O sungula na {start_chips} mbanji
• Deki moja ya 52 kadi (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• O muthu wa muthu wa kasa (muthu wa nyumba)
• Kila zole i landa kulingana na Ultimate Texas Hold'em: o posa ANTE na BLIND bets, o pata 2 kadi za muthu, o kubemba kuhusu PLAY bets kulingana na fases ya muthu, kisha o mona kadi za komunidad na ulinganisha muthu wako wa 5 kadi na wa muthu wa kasa. O lengo lyo ni kuongeza mbanji yako (wakati o na muthu wa mabore), wakati o kupunguza hasara yako (wakati o na muthu wa mabaya).
• Muthu wa muthu unaisha wakati o fika 0 mbanji au chini pa kuanza kwa zole (HASARA) au kukamilisha 1000 zole na mbanji (USHINDI)

💰 NZINGA YA KUBEMBA:
• ANTE: Kubemba ${ante} kila zole
• BLIND: Kubemba ${ante} kila zole
• PLAY: Kubemba kulingana na muthu. Kulingana na zole, o pata chaguo moja tu ya kufuata: (${ante4} wakati wa PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} wakati wa FLOP, au ${ante} wakati wa RIVER. O pia pata chaguo la kukunja kwa river, na kuacha muthu, na kutoa kubemba.)

🎴 NZINGA YA KADI:
• O pata 2 kadi za muthu (kadi za muthu wako)
• Muthu wa kasa pata 2 kadi za kuficha (kuficha kwa wewe)
• 5 kadi za komunidad zinapatikana kwanza
• Kadi za komunidad zinaonyeshwa kulingana na fases ya muthu

🏆 NZINGA YA MUTHU WA KASA:
• Muthu wa kasa lazima awe na angalau PAIR (2 kadi za mlinganyo) ili kuhalalishwa, kwa kutumia 2 kadi za muthu wao na 5 kadi za komunidad.
• Kuhalalishwa kwa muthu wa kasa kunaathiri matokeo ya kubemba, kama itaelezwa baadaye.

🎮 FASES YA MUTHU & VITENDO:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Vitendo: [4x] (${ante4}) au [check]
  • [4x]: Weka ${ante4} PLAY bet, inaonyesha kadi 3 za komunidad
  • [check]: Hakuna kubemba zaidi, inaonyesha kadi 3 za komunidad

📋 FLOP:
  • Ikiwa 4x bet iliwekwa: Chaguo la [skip] pekee linalopatikana (kufichua kadi 2 za mwisho za komunidad)
  • Ikiwa hakuna 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) au [check]
  • [2x]: Weka ${ante2} PLAY bet, inaonyesha kadi 2 za mwisho za komunidad
  • [check]: Hakuna kubemba zaidi, inaonyesha kadi 2 za mwisho za komunidad

📋 RIVER:
  • Ikiwa 4x au 2x bet iliwekwa: Chaguo la [skip] pekee linalopatikana (kufichua kadi za mwisho na kuendelea na muthu)
  • Ikiwa hakuna PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) au [fold]
  • [1x]: Weka ${ante} PLAY bet, inaendelea na muthu
  • [fold]: Kuacha muthu, kupoteza ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kadi zote zinaonyeshwa na kutathminiwa
  • Muthu wa 5 kadi bora kutoka kwa 7 kadi (2 kadi za muthu + 5 kadi za komunidad)
  • Kubemba kulingana na kanuni za malipo

💎 MALIPO YA KUBEMBA:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Muthu wa kasa hana uhalali: PUSH (kubemba kurejeshwa)
  • Muthu wa kasa ana uhalali & o ushindi: 1:1 malipo (kubemba + ushindi)
  • Muthu wa kasa ana uhalali & o hasara: Kubemba kupotea
  • Tie: PUSH (kubemba kurejeshwa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Haiathiriwi na uhalali wa muthu wa kasa
  • O ushindi: Kubemba kurejeshwa na malipo ya ziada kulingana na nguvu ya muthu wako
  • O hasara: Kubemba kupotea
  • Tie: PUSH (kubemba kurejeshwa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Hakuna malipo ya ziada

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Haiathiriwi na uhalali wa muthu wa kasa
  • Ulinganisho wa moja kwa moja: Muthu wako bora vs Muthu wa kasa
  • O ushindi: 1:1 malipo (kubemba + ushindi)
  • O hasara: Kubemba kupotea
  • Tie: PUSH (kubemba kurejeshwa)

🎯 NZINGA YA MUTHU (Bora hadi Mbaya):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ya mlinganyo
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kadi za mlinganyo
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kadi za mlinganyo
  4. Full House: 3 kadi za mlinganyo + 2 kadi za mlinganyo
  5. Flush: 5 kadi za mlinganyo
  6. Straight: 5 kadi za mfululizo
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kadi za mlinganyo
  8. Two Pair: 2 jozi za mlinganyo tofauti
  9. One Pair: 2 kadi za mlinganyo
  10. High Card: Kadi ya juu inashinda

⌨️  AMRI ZA VITENDO:
• [4x] au [play bet 4x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] au [play bet 2x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] au [play bet 1x]: Weka ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] au [c]: Check (hakuna kubemba zaidi)
• [fold] au [f]: Fold (kuacha muthu)
• [skip] au [s]: Skip hadi hatua inayofuata (wakati hakuna kitendo kinachohitajika)

💡 MAONI YA MKAKATI:
• Muthu wa kuanzia wenye nguvu (jozi, kadi za juu) mara nyingi hupatana na 4x bets
• Zingatia uhalali wa muthu wa kasa - muthu dhaifu inaweza kushinda ikiwa muthu wa kasa hana uhalali
• BLIND bet inaweza kuwa faida kubwa na muthu wenye nguvu (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Angalia mbanji yako! Ikiwa itafika 0 au chini pa kuanza kwa zole, o hasara.

⚠️  Kumbuka MUHIMU:
• ANTE na BLIND bets ni lazima kila zole
• PLAY bets ni chaguo na mkakati
• Hakikisha o ingiza kitendo sahihi, na kitendo kimoja tu wakati mmoja.
